title: Framework ModSecurity v3 Git wrapper does not bind a verified host Git executable before provenance validation
title_de: Framework-ModSecurity-v3-Git-Wrapper bindet vor der Provenance-Validierung kein verifiziertes Host-Git-Programm
profile: standalone Framework fetch and provenance boundary at Framework master f98a8739cb13b583f23d646784b144e596b61441
summary: The standalone Framework ModSecurity v3 provenance wrapper sanitizes Git configuration and transport inputs but invokes an unqualified `git` resolved from the caller's PATH before it can verify source provenance. Existing regressions intentionally substitute a fake Git through PATH to model approved Git arguments, so they do not establish a verified host-executable boundary.
summary_de: Der eigenständige Framework-ModSecurity-v3-Provenance-Wrapper bereinigt Git-Konfigurations- und Transporteingaben, ruft aber vor der Source-Provenance-Prüfung ein unqualifiziertes über den aufrufenden PATH aufgelöstes `git` auf. Bestehende Regressionen ersetzen Git absichtlich über PATH durch ein Fake-Git, um freigegebene Git-Argumente zu modellieren; sie belegen daher keine verifizierte Host-Executable-Grenze.
observed_behavior: At exact clean Framework master f98a8739cb13b583f23d646784b144e596b61441, ci_modsecurity_v3_git clears inherited Git state and then executes bare `git -c ... "$@"`. The source path has no absolute host-Git binding or PATH reset. The provenance regression creates a temporary bin/git and prepends it to PATH, which proves argument/provenance handling with a model Git rather than which host executable production invokes.
observed_behavior_de: Auf dem exakten sauberen Framework-master f98a8739cb13b583f23d646784b144e596b61441 löscht ci_modsecurity_v3_git geerbten Git-Zustand und führt anschließend nacktes `git -c ... "$@"` aus. Der Source-Pfad besitzt weder eine absolute Host-Git-Bindung noch ein PATH-Reset. Die Provenance-Regression erstellt ein temporäres bin/git und stellt es PATH voran; das beweist Argument-/Provenance-Behandlung mit einem Modell-Git, nicht welches Host-Programm die Produktion ausführt.
expected_behavior: Before any standalone fresh fetch, checkout, or recursive submodule command reaches Git, the Framework must resolve and bind an approved host Git executable independently of a caller-controlled PATH, fail closed when that trusted executable cannot be established, and retain regressions that distinguish test-only fake Git injection from production host-executable selection.
expected_behavior_de: Bevor ein eigenständiger Fresh-Fetch-, Checkout- oder rekursiver Submodule-Befehl Git erreicht, muss das Framework ein freigegebenes Host-Git-Programm unabhängig von einem aufruferkontrollierten PATH auflösen und binden, beim Fehlen dieses vertrauenswürdigen Programms fail closed enden und Regressionen behalten, die Test-only-Fake-Git-Injektion von der Produktionsauswahl des Host-Programms trennen.
impact: If a lower-privileged actor can influence PATH in a supported standalone Framework fetch invocation, a substituted Git program can run with the Framework/CI identity before source provenance validation. The static review has not demonstrated such a supported untrusted PATH source, so this is a plausible medium hardening gap rather than a validated exploit or high/critical finding.
impact_de: Falls ein weniger privilegierter Akteur PATH in einer unterstützten eigenständigen Framework-Fetch-Invocation beeinflussen kann, kann ein ersetztes Git-Programm mit der Framework-/CI-Identität vor der Source-Provenance-Validierung laufen. Das statische Review hat eine solche unterstützte untrusted-PATH-Quelle nicht belegt; dies ist daher eine plausible mittlere Hardening-Lücke und kein validierter Exploit oder High-/Critical-Finding.
preconditions: A supported standalone Framework fetch/provisioning invocation inherits a PATH whose earlier entry can be controlled by a less-trusted actor.
The invocation reaches ci_modsecurity_v3_git before a verified absolute Git executable is bound.
The substituted executable is executable by the Framework/CI process.
reproduction: Inspect exact Framework master f98a8739cb13b583f23d646784b144e596b61441 ci/lib/common.sh around ci_modsecurity_v3_git and confirm that the invoked command is bare git.
Inspect tests/security_regression/test_modsecurity_v3_git_ref_provenance.py and confirm that create_fixture writes bin/git and prepends that directory to PATH for its model-Git controls.
Do not treat the test-only fake Git as proof of a productive untrusted PATH actor; establish that supported actor/control boundary before any exploit classification.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped git rev-parse/status, rg -n -C 14 ci_modsecurity_v3_git, and sha256sum on the clean exact Framework master source
evidence.summary: Exact clean Framework master is f98a8739cb13b583f23d646784b144e596b61441 and ci_modsecurity_v3_git invokes bare git from PATH at the provenance boundary.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped rg -n -C 8 fake_bin|fake Git|fake_git_script|PATH and sha256sum on the clean exact Framework master regression source
evidence.summary: The regression intentionally writes a fake git executable and prepends its directory to PATH; it validates modeled Git arguments but not production host-Git identity.

evidence.command: make test-modsecurity-v3-provenance-contract; python -m unittest discover -s tests/security_regression -p test_modsecurity_v3_git_ref_provenance.py -q; PR #44 and current-master hosted-check readback
evidence.summary: Current Framework master 47e50e7bc43ba7a3b5bad1a9448111794f664cc0 binds the approved host Git before provenance commands; focused fake-PATH rejection and approved-host legitimate controls pass without relaxing source provenance or FND-FRAMEWORK-0036 containment.

root_cause: The provenance wrapper was designed to remove inherited Git configuration, hooks, transports, credentials, and selected Git behavior, but it retained ambient command resolution. No Framework-local host-tool trust contract resolves an approved absolute Git program before the standalone source-provisioning boundary.
root_cause_de: Der Provenance-Wrapper wurde entworfen, um geerbte Git-Konfiguration, Hooks, Transporte, Credentials und ausgewähltes Git-Verhalten zu entfernen, behielt aber die umgebende Command-Auflösung. Kein Framework-lokaler Host-Tool-Trust-Contract löst vor der eigenständigen Source-Provisioning-Grenze ein freigegebenes absolutes Git-Programm auf.
proposed_remediation: Define the supported host-tool trust contract, resolve a trusted absolute Git executable before the boundary without trusting caller PATH, verify its permitted location/ownership or other approved provenance, and make ci_modsecurity_v3_git fail closed when that contract is unmet. Add focused regressions proving a non-approved PATH Git is not invoked while an approved host-Git control still completes the legitimate pinned fetch/check-out path. Preserve the separate FND-FRAMEWORK-0036 fresh-root containment controls.
proposed_remediation_de: Den unterstützten Host-Tool-Trust-Contract definieren, vor der Grenze ein vertrauenswürdiges absolutes Git-Programm ohne Vertrauen in den aufrufenden PATH auflösen, dessen zulässigen Ort/Ownership oder andere freigegebene Provenance prüfen und ci_modsecurity_v3_git bei nicht erfülltem Contract fail closed machen. Fokussierte Regressionen ergänzen, die belegen, dass nicht freigegebenes PATH-Git nicht aufgerufen wird, während ein freigegebenes Host-Git-Control den legitimen gepinnten Fetch-/Checkout-Pfad abschließt. Die getrennten FND-FRAMEWORK-0036-Fresh-Root-Containment-Controls erhalten.
acceptance_criteria: The production standalone ModSecurity v3 wrapper cannot resolve Git from an untrusted caller PATH.
The selected Git executable has an explicit, documented, fail-closed host trust contract before it receives fetch, checkout, or submodule arguments.
A focused regression proves that a fake Git earlier on PATH is not invoked by the production wrapper.
A legitimate approved host-Git control still fetches/checks out the pinned ModSecurity v3 graph under the existing provenance and FND-FRAMEWORK-0036 containment controls.
The exact Framework PR head receives security review, focused tests, relevant CI/Sonar evidence, and resulting-master verification without weakening PATH, provenance, or quality controls.
validation_plan: Establish whether any supported Framework or CI caller gives a less-trusted actor PATH control and document the result before changing severity or exploitability.
Implement the approved host-Git binding only in an isolated Framework task/PR and run focused fake-PATH block and approved-host-Git legitimate controls.
Re-run FND-FRAMEWORK-0036 fresh-root worktree, attribute/filter, and recursive-update regressions because both findings share the same pre-provenance Git command boundary.
Collect exact-head review, CI, Sonar, and resulting-master evidence before changing this status from triaged/fixed to verified.
regression_tests: tests/security_regression/test_modsecurity_v3_git_ref_provenance.py with a non-approved fake Git earlier on PATH and an approved host-Git control.
Focused standalone fetch-smoke-sources invocation that reaches init, fetch, checkout, and recursive submodule handling without ambient PATH Git resolution.
legitimate_control_tests: The approved host Git can complete the pinned legitimate ModSecurity v3 fetch/check-out graph.
Existing source-origin, commit, TLS, hook, fsmonitor, optional-lock, submodule, and fresh-root containment controls remain enforced.
dependencies: A Framework-approved host-tool provenance contract for Git.
FND-FRAMEWORK-0036 fresh-root checkout containment and recursive local-configuration scrubbing remediation.
evidence_limitations: This is a static source-and-regression review; no exploit, untrusted productive PATH source, or runtime command substitution was exercised.
The test fake Git is an intentional model control and is not evidence that a supported production caller permits hostile PATH injection.
The Parent invocation may bind PATH separately; this finding is limited to the standalone Framework fetch/provenance path.
residual_risk: The ambient-PATH source review applies to historical revision f98a8739cb13b583f23d646784b144e596b61441. Current Framework master binds approved host Git before provenance commands and rejects the fake-PATH negative control; the successful legitimate control preserves the remaining source-origin, commit, TLS, hook, fsmonitor, optional-lock, submodule, and fresh-root containment controls. No risk acceptance is recorded.
residual_risk_de: Das Review der umgebenden PATH-Auflösung betrifft die historische Revision f98a8739cb13b583f23d646784b144e596b61441. Der aktuelle Framework-master bindet freigegebenes Host-Git vor Provenance-Befehlen und weist das Fake-PATH-Negativ-Control ab; das erfolgreiche legitime Control erhält die übrigen Source-Origin-, Commit-, TLS-, Hook-, fsmonitor-, optional-lock-, Submodule- und Fresh-Root-Containment-Controls. Es ist keine Risikoakzeptanz erfasst.

history.detail: Exact clean Framework master f98a8739cb13b583f23d646784b144e596b61441 invokes bare git through PATH at the ModSecurity v3 provenance boundary. The test suite intentionally supplies fake Git through PATH but does not establish a productive untrusted actor. This is a separate P2/medium/probable candidate, not a duplicate of the local-config, mutable-byte, materialization, or fresh-root findings. No product source, Framework branch/PR, Parent gitlink, or MRTS state changed.

PR #44 source hardening and current master 47e50e7bc43ba7a3b5bad1a9448111794f664cc0 provide the host-Git binding. The focused fake-PATH rejection and approved-host legitimate controls passed together with the FND-FRAMEWORK-0036 containment regressions; no security control was weakened.
